nodes.description: Public vault identifier used to index factory fee/asset lookups.
Manager address with privileged control over fees, features and metadata.
Address of the underlying NFT asset (ERC721/ERC1155) held by the vault.
Reference to the vault factory used for fees, exclusions and pause checks.
Enumerable set of token ids currently held by the vault, mutated during mint/redeem/swap.
Mapping of token id to held quantity for ERC1155 vaults.
Nonce mixed into pseudo-randomness used to select a token id for random redeems.
Flags whether minting is currently enabled for the vault.
nonReentrant entry point that pulls NFTs, mints vault shares and charges fees.
nonReentrant entry point that burns shares, charges fees and withdraws NFTs to a recipient.
nonReentrant entry point swapping NFTs in and out with fee charging.
Internal function that transfers NFTs from the caller into the vault and updates holdings.
Internal function that removes tokens from holdings and transfers them to a recipient.
Internal fee charging routine that transfers tokens to the fee distributor and calls distribute.
Internal helper performing a low-level call to transfer an ERC721 token out of the vault.
Internal helper performing a low-level call to pull an ERC721 token into the vault.
Internal pseudo-random token selection using block data, timestamp and randNonce.
Flash loan entry point that delegates to ERC20FlashMintUpgradeable and invokes the receiver callback.
Internal access-control guard checking manager or owner identity.
Internal guard reverting when a lock id is paused and the caller is not the owner.
Deploys a new beacon proxy vault, registers it and initializes fee receivers.
Factory function setting per-vault fee parameters, callable by owner or the vault itself.
Hardcoded dev address function enabling random swap features.
Privileged function changing the vault manager address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, NFT pulls and fee exclusion.
Miner-influenced timestamp fed into random token selection.
Low-level call transferring an ERC721 token out of the vault to a user-supplied recipient.
Low-level staticcall/call used to pull an ERC721 token from the caller with attacker-influenced asset address.
External onFlashLoan call to an arbitrary receiver contract before allowances are settled.
External safeTransferFrom/safeBatchTransferFrom calls on the asset contract transferring NFTs.
External call to fee distributor distribute() executed after token transfer during fee charging.
Caller-supplied array of NFT token ids.
Caller-supplied array of ERC1155 amounts.
Recipient address for minted shares or withdrawn NFTs.
Number of shares to burn during redeem.
Caller-supplied array of specific token ids to withdraw.
Flash loan receiver contract implementing the callback.
ABI-encoded initialization data for eligibility modules.
Count of NFTs received, used to compute minted shares.
Computed fee amount charged to the user.
Pseudo-random index derived from block data and randNonce.
Array of token ids being withdrawn from the vault.

edges.reason: mintTo uses msg.sender as the destination for minted shares and NFT pulls.
onlyPrivileged authorizes based on msg.sender compared to manager/owner.
setManager is gated by the onlyPrivileged modifier.
onlyPrivileged controls privileged configuration entry points.
assignDefaultFeatures compares msg.sender to a hardcoded dev address.
tokenIds parameter flows into receiveNFTs for transfer and holdings updates.
amounts parameter flows into receiveNFTs for ERC1155 accounting.
receiveNFTs returns the NFT count consumed by mintTo to mint shares.
count is multiplied by base to compute minted shares.
mintTo calls _chargeAndDistributeFees after state updates, exposing fee transfer logic.
totalFee is computed and passed into _chargeAndDistributeFees.
Fee charging transfers tokens then calls distributor.distribute on an external contract.
distribute() can re-enter the vault through fee receiver logic.
withdrawNFTsTo returns redeemed ids used by redeemTo.
redeemedIds array is emitted by redeemTo.
withdrawNFTsTo invokes transferERC721 for ERC721 withdrawals.
receiveNFTs invokes transferFromERC721 to pull ERC721 tokens.
transferERC721 performs the low-level call to the asset contract.
transferFromERC721 performs low-level staticcall/call to the asset contract.
receiveNFTs triggers external safeTransferFrom calls into attacker-controlled NFT contracts.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault supplies the token id for random withdrawals.
block.timestamp is mixed into the pseudo-random token selection.
randNonce is used as weak entropy and incremented in random selection.
holdings.length and holdings.at are used to pick the random token id.
flashLoan executes external receiver.onFlashLoan callback.
The flash loan receiver can re-enter the vault during the callback.
receiver parameter defines the callback target of the flash loan.
amount parameter determines the flash loan amount minted and burned.
flashLoan checks msg.sender against owner when the flashloan lock is paused.
mintTo is guarded by onlyOwnerIfPaused control.
redeemTo is guarded by onlyOwnerIfPaused control.
swapTo is guarded by onlyOwnerIfPaused control.
Vault setFees forwards to vaultFactory.setVaultFees which trusts the calling vault.
_chargeAndDistributeFees reads excludedFromFees and feeDistributor from the factory.
mintTo requires enableMint to be true.
receiveNFTs pulls tokens from the configured assetAddress.
withdrawNFTsTo transfers tokens out from the configured assetAddress.
createVault deploys the beacon proxy vaults referenced by vaultFactory.
to parameter designates the share recipient in mintTo.
specificIds parameter selects tokens to withdraw in withdrawNFTsTo.
initData is supplied to eligibility deployment during vault setup.
randomIndex local derives the position used to read holdings.

normalization_plan.reason: Token id array is only meaningful as the input consumed by receiveNFTs.
ERC1155 amounts are only used inside receiveNFTs accounting.
Recipient address parameter is consumed directly by the minting function.
Redeem amount parameter is only used to compute burned shares in redeemTo.
Specific id array selects tokens inside the withdrawal routine.
Flash loan receiver is only consumed by the flashLoan function.
Encoded init data is only consumed during vault/eligibility deployment.
NFT count local is computed by receiveNFTs and used to mint shares.
Fee local is computed and immediately passed to the fee charging routine.
Random index local exists only as an intermediate inside random selection.
Redeemed ids array is built inside and returned from the withdrawal routine.
